description: Find the earliest date a traveler can legally re-enter Schengen and the longest consecutive stay possible, from trips explicitly provided in this request. Trip dates are processed in memory and not stored. For planning only, not legal advice.

referenceDate.description: Date to evaluate, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

trips.description: Schengen trips. Entry and exit are YYYY-MM-DD; exit is inclusive. Omit exit for a single day.

name: schengen_earliest_reentry
